# ForensicAnvil

> Professional digital forensics toolkit for IT experts specializing in Windows analysis, data extraction, and cyber investigation.

ForensicAnvil is a comprehensive suite of forensic analysis tools developed by Semyon Strezhnev for computer expertise and digital investigation. The platform provides specialized utilities for Windows registry analysis, browser history parsing, USB device scanning, and file forensics.

## Key Topics

- Digital Forensics
- Windows Registry Analysis
- Browser History Parser
- File Search & Analysis
- USB Device Scanner
- Data Extraction
- Autostart Programs
- Mobile Forensics
- Cyber Attack Investigation
- Windows 10/11 Analysis
- RunMRU & UserAssist
- Chrome, Firefox, Edge
- EXIF Data Analysis
- Forensic Tools
- IT Expertise

## Core Platform

- [ForensicAnvil Homepage](https://forensicanvil.ru): Professional digital forensics tools suite homepage
- [Tools Catalog](https://forensicanvil.ru/tools): Main tools catalog: Windows registry, network traffic, disk analysis
- [About ForensicAnvil](https://forensicanvil.ru/about): About ForensicAnvil project and creator Semyon Strezhnev

## Forensic Analysis Tools

- [Windows Registry Program History Analyzer](https://forensicanvil.ru/tools/analyze-reestr-program-history): Windows registry RunMRU/UserAssist analysis tool documentation
- [Browser History Parser](https://forensicanvil.ru/tools/parser-browser-history): Browser history parser for Chrome, Firefox, Edge analysis
- [USB Scanner](https://forensicanvil.ru/tools/usb-scanner): USB device scanner and analysis tool for forensic investigation
- [File Search Tool](https://forensicanvil.ru/tools/file-search): Professional file search with keyword matching, EXIF, MD5 support
- [Autostart Programs Analyzer](https://forensicanvil.ru/tools/analyze-starting-programs): Windows autostart programs analyzer with registry scanning
